```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # 09:00 Beijing time (UTC+8)

permissions:
  discussions: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  post:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Set current date
        id: date
        run: echo "DATE=$(date +'%Y-%m-%d')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get discussion category ID
        id: cat
        run: |
          CATEGORY_NAME="coffee-lottery"
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/discussions/categories)
          ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r ".[] | select(.name==\"$CATEGORY_NAME\") | .id")
          echo "CATEGORY_ID=$ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create daily coffee lottery discussion
        run: |
          TITLE="Daily Coffee Lottery - ${{ steps.date.outputs.DATE }}"
          BODY=$(cat <<'EOF'
Good morning! ☕️

**Today's Coffee Lottery Details**

- **Date:** ${{ steps.date.outputs.DATE }}
- **Lottery Number:** *[Insert lottery number here]*
- **Winner Announcement:** *[Winner will be announced after the lottery]*

Good luck to everyone! 🎉
EOF
          )
          CATEGORY_ID=${{ steps.cat.outputs.CATEGORY_ID }}
          JSON=$(jq -n --arg title "$TITLE" --arg body "$BODY" --argjson category_id "$CATEGORY_ID" \
            '{"title":$title,"body":$body,"category_id":$category_id}')
          curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$JSON" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/discussions
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
